denied.message: {action} needs a permission you don't have.
denied.note: action is one of the action.* phrases. People read who can help, never the permission key (review X-1); API clients read the key from the problem's permission field

deniedAsk.message: {action} needs a permission you don't have. Ask {helpers}.
deniedAsk.note: helpers: names joined as 'A, B or C'

group.campaigns.note: a group of permissions in the role editor, an overline

perm.campaigns:view.about: See campaigns, their content, audience and status.
perm.campaigns:edit.about: Create and edit drafts, request approval.
perm.campaigns:send.about: Start or schedule a send, and resume a paused one.
perm.campaigns:pause: Pause or cancel a live send
perm.campaigns:pause.about: Stop a send that is running. Resuming needs campaigns:send.
perm.campaigns:approve.about: Approve, reject or request changes on sends that need approval.
perm.templates:edit.about: Create, edit and delete templates and saved sections.
perm.transactional:view.about: See transactional templates, the message log and its numbers. Never message content.
perm.transactional:edit.about: Create and edit template drafts, import templates.
perm.transactional:publish.about: Make a draft the live version, or roll back to an earlier one.
perm.transactional:send: Send through the API or SMTP
perm.transactional:send.about: Send transactional messages from your product. Send-only keys hold this alone.
perm.transactional:content: View the content of sent messages
perm.transactional:content.about: Open the rendered content of a sent message. Every view is logged.
perm.automations:view.about: See flows and their live stats.
perm.subscribers:create.about: Add contacts through signup forms and the API.
perm.subscribers:edit.about: Change fields, tags and list membership.
perm.subscribers:import.about: Run the importer. Consent is always kept.
perm.subscribers:export.about: Download contacts. Every export is logged.
perm.subscribers:delete.about: Permanently erase a contact's personal data.
perm.subscribers:verify.about: Send contacts' addresses to a verification service. It spends credits; every use is logged.
perm.segments:edit.about: Build segments with the condition builder.
perm.segments:sql.about: Write read-only SQL against a contacts view.
perm.forms:edit.about: Change signup forms, the preference center and the archive.
perm.reports:share.about: Share a report with people outside the workspace.
perm.deliverability:view.about: See domain, IP and provider health.
perm.providers:view.about: See provider status and routing. Never credentials.
perm.providers:manage: Manage providers, credentials, routing and failover
perm.providers:manage.about: Connect providers, replace credentials, change routing.
perm.domains:manage.about: Add sending domains and sender identities.
perm.team:invite.about: Invite people with roles you hold.
perm.team:manage.about: Change roles, deactivate and remove members.
perm.apikeys:manage.about: Create, rotate and revoke API keys.
perm.webhooks:manage.about: Add webhook endpoints and see delivery logs.
perm.mcp:manage.about: Create and revoke AI agents and see their actions.
perm.integrations:view: See integrations, their activity and webhooks
perm.integrations:view.about: See the integrations hub, each integration's health, activity and managed webhooks.
perm.integrations:manage: Connect, change, take over and disconnect integrations
perm.integrations:manage.about: Creates, changes and revokes the integrations' keys and webhooks.
perm.ai:use.about: Subject ideas, rewrites, translations and alt text with the workspace's own model.
perm.scoring:edit: Edit scoring rules, decay and bands
perm.placement:run.about: Send copies through the workspace's providers to its own seed mailboxes.
perm.placement:manage: Add, reconnect and remove seed mailboxes
perm.placement:manage.about: Their passwords and tokens can read whole mailboxes.
perm.grow:view.about: See referrals, referrers, rewards and recommendations.
perm.grow:edit: Edit the referral program, its rewards and recommendations
perm.grow:edit.about: Change the program, its milestones and rewards, and the newsletters you recommend.
perm.grow:review: Review held referrals, pause links, resend and fulfill rewards
perm.grow:review.about: Decide on held referrals and handle rewards.
perm.grow:connect: Connect, pause and end partner links
perm.grow:connect.about: Exchange signed subscribe links with other ReputeCast instances.
perm.earn:view: View revenue, paid members, gifts and sponsors
perm.earn:view.about: See Earn's numbers, paid members, gifts and sponsor bookings.
perm.earn:edit: Edit tiers, prices, offers, gift options and the Earn pages
perm.earn:edit.about: Change what readers pay and the upgrade, cancel and gift pages.
perm.earn:manage: Manage paid members: complimentary access, imports, cancellations
perm.earn:manage.about: Grant complimentary access, import paid members, cancel subscriptions and change gifts.
perm.payments:manage: Connect and manage payment providers, their keys and webhooks
perm.payments:manage.about: Connect Stripe and change its keys and webhook.
perm.sponsors:manage: Manage sponsors, bookings and sponsor payment status
perm.sponsors:manage.about: Keep the sponsor library and book sponsors into issues.
perm.conversions:create.about: Report a conversion with its value. The Conversions key preset holds this alone.
perm.website:view: View posts, pages and website numbers
perm.website:view.about: See the website's posts, pages, members and numbers.
perm.website:edit.about: Write and change drafts of posts and pages.
perm.website:publish: Publish, schedule and unpublish posts and pages
perm.website:publish.about: Put posts and pages on the website, or take them down.
perm.website:manage: Manage the website: turn it on or off, home, navigation, tags, members, meter and paywall
perm.website:manage.about: Change how the website works and who can read what.
perm.products:view.about: See digital products, their sales and orders.
perm.products:edit.about: Change products' files, descriptions and drafts.
perm.products:publish: Publish, archive and change the price of products
perm.products:publish.about: Put products on sale, take them off and change what they cost.
perm.orders:manage: Manage orders: new links, revoking and restoring access
perm.orders:manage.about: Send new download links and change buyers' access.
perm.sms:send: Send or schedule SMS campaigns, and publish automations with SMS steps
perm.sms:send.about: Needed with campaigns:send to send text messages.
perm.push:send: Send or schedule push campaigns, and publish automations with push steps
perm.push:send.about: Needed with campaigns:send to send push notifications.
perm.whatsapp:send: Send or schedule WhatsApp campaigns, and publish automations with WhatsApp steps
perm.whatsapp:send.about: Needed with campaigns:send to send WhatsApp messages.
perm.audit:view.about: See who did what, when and from where.
perm.workspace:manage.about: Name, default sender, timezone and the approval policy.
perm.workspace:delete.about: Delete the workspace and everything in it.
perm.agency:view: View the agency overview and search across your clients
perm.agency:view.about: See every assigned client's health, next send, approvals waiting and incidents, and search across them.
perm.agency:usage: See usage and costs per client, set rebill rates and export usage
perm.agency:usage.about: Emails, texts, notifications and provider costs per client and month, with what to rebill.
perm.agency:library: Manage the shared library and workspace templates
perm.agency:library.about: Add, change and remove library items and workspace templates, and copy them into clients.
perm.agency:manage: Create and delete client workspaces, and manage staff and assignments
perm.agency:manage.about: Create and delete clients, add and remove staff, and assign them to clients.
role.owner.about: Everything, including transferring ownership and deleting the workspace
role.admin.about: Everything except transferring ownership and deleting the workspace
role.editor.about: View everything; edit campaigns, templates, automations, segments (no SQL) and forms; send, pause and publish; import contacts
role.agency_manager.about: Every client, staff, templates, usage and rates
role.account_manager.about: The clients they're assigned to: overview, search, usage and the library
role.client_approver.about: Sees campaigns, templates, automations, reports, deliverability and contacts (no export); approves sends
role.client_viewer.about: Sees campaigns, templates, automations, reports and deliverability; no contacts
